question: Will the energy truce come back, yes or no?

lines.text: Russia says it shot down 644 Ukrainian drones overnight, over 26 regions and Crimea.
Mayor Sergei Sobyanin says 94 were downed on their way to Moscow.
Nearly 160 flights were delayed or cancelled at Moscow's four main airports.
In Rostov, the governor reports about 50 drones and projectiles, and one man injured.
In Vladimir, the governor says heating infrastructure was targeted, with minor damage.
On Thursday, drones set fire to the Ryazan refinery, one of Russia's largest.
Zelensky says Ukraine is no longer bound by any restrictions on such attacks.

scene.quote: no longer bound by any restrictions on such attacks

lines.text: Last weekend, Trump announced both sides had agreed not to hit each other's energy sites.
Now Trump says the strikes push up world oil prices, adding: I think that's a disgrace.

scene.quote: Well, I think that's a disgrace

lines.text: Putin says the attacks caused nothing particularly significant.
Russian strikes left 370,000 people in Ukraine's Volyn region without power.
Zelensky says Ukraine could pause again, but only with more US Patriot missiles.
Will the energy truce come back, yes or no?
